categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in five segments: Alumina (including bauxite mining, alumina production, and sales), Primary Aluminum (including electrolytic aluminum production, carbon products, aluminum alloy products), Energy (coal mining, thermal power, wind power, photovoltaic power, and new energy equipment manufacturing), Marketing (domestic and international sales of alumina, aluminum products, other non-ferrous metals, coal, and logistics services), and Headquarters & Others (including R&D and other related activities).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced alumina refining and electrolytic aluminum production technologies, including energy-efficient and low-carbon processes. It emphasizes technology innovation with dedicated research institutes, industrial pilot lines, and advanced automation such as remote control cranes and digital management platforms. The company also applies green metallurgy, energy-saving, and carbon reduction technologies, and promotes smart factory construction and digital transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic electrolytic aluminum producers for alumina products, aluminum processing enterprises and distributors for primary aluminum products, and regional power grid companies for energy products. The company serves industries such as automotive, aerospace, packaging, construction, electronics, and new energy sectors like photovoltaics and electric vehicles, both domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant production bases in provinces such as Shandong, Shanxi, Guangxi, Inner Mongolia, Yunnan, and Guizhou. It also has overseas operations, including bauxite mining and alumina production in Guinea and other countries. Overseas assets account for about 7% of total assets. The company’s products are sold domestically and exported internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Aluminum Corporation Limited is an integrated upstream and midstream player in the aluminum industry supply chain. It controls bauxite mining (upstream), alumina refining, electrolytic aluminum production (midstream), and also engages in downstream activities such as aluminum alloy production, carbon products, and logistics services. It also operates energy production facilities supporting its aluminum smelting operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes becoming a globally competitive world-class aluminum company with strengths in resource acquisition, technological innovation, advanced materials, and green low-carbon digital transformation. R&D priorities include green aluminum production technologies, energy-saving and carbon reduction in aluminum smelting, resource utilization of bauxite, and development of high-purity aluminum and aluminum alloys. The company fosters collaboration with universities and external partners and invests in smart manufacturing and digital platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of alumina, primary aluminum, aluminum alloy products, carbon products, coal, and electricity. The company also earns income from logistics services, international trade, and technology licensing. Sales are conducted via long-term contracts, spot market sales, futures contracts, and integrated supply chain services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of the largest aluminum producers globally and the leading alumina and electrolytic aluminum producer in China, the company holds a dominant market position. It competes with other major domestic and international aluminum producers but benefits from a vertically integrated supply chain and strong resource base. Its focus on green and digital transformation further differentiates it in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 237 billion, a 5.2% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.4 billion, an 85% increase. Total assets reached RMB 216 billion with a stable asset-liability ratio of 48.1%. The company’s operating cash flow increased by 21.4%, reflecting strong growth and improved operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive and vertically integrated aluminum industry chain, stable and abundant bauxite resources (domestic and overseas), leading production capacity in alumina and electrolytic aluminum, and advanced technological innovation capabilities. It highlights its commitment to green, low-carbon, and digital transformation, offering high-quality, energy-efficient aluminum products and solutions tailored to emerging industries such as new energy vehicles and photovoltaics.
